corpus.update_scenario: index all selected tags except the newest N=5 first, then index the remaining 5 tags as an incremental update

context_budget.token_estimate: bytes / 4 over the concatenated plaintext of all selected revisions' indexed source files
context_budget.requirement: measured plaintext token size of the selected corpus must exceed context_budget.tokens

rationale: Budgets are set for a developer laptop running FalkorDB locally. 30 minutes for a one-off initial import of ~160 releases is acceptable; an update adding a handful of releases must reuse unchanged blobs and finish within 2 minutes; 2 GB peak Python memory and 1 GB graph size keep the index feasible on a laptop; paged queries (limit 50) must answer interactively (p95 <= 2 s) so an agent can iterate through pages. Any query failure counts against the budget; truncation is allowed but must be reported.
